concepts.title: Exponential Notation
concepts.definition: Repeated multiplication of the same factor is written in shorthand as base raised to an exponent: n multiplied by itself a times is n to the power a; the base is the repeated factor and the exponent counts how many times it appears.
concepts.key_idea: 5 x 5 x 5 x 5 = 5 to the 4th power = 625; exponent counts the self-multiplications.
question_patterns: express 6 x 6 x 6 x 6 in exponential form and find the value
evaluate 5 to the power 4
what is the value of 2 raised to the power 10
write a x a x a x b x b using exponents
find the numerical value of 7 squared times 2 cubed
express 32400 as a product of prime factors in exponential form

solution_steps.action: raise the base to the exponent
solution_steps.explain: The value of the notation is the base multiplied by itself exponent times.

concepts.title: Multiplying Powers with the Same Base
concepts.definition: When two powers of the same base are multiplied, the result is the base raised to the sum of the exponents, because the repeated factors simply pool together.
concepts.key_idea: n to a times n to b equals n to a plus b: 3 to 4 times 3 to 3 is 3 to 7.
concepts.textbook_ref: hegp102.txt lines 330-344 (na x nb), 385-427 (power of a power, ma x na)
question_patterns: simplify 3 to the power 4 times 3 to the power 3 in exponential form
write the product p to the 4th times p to the 6th as a single power
evaluate 2 to the power 9 using the product rule
find 2 to the 4th times 3 to the 4th as a power of 6
what is 5 squared times 5 cubed - give the value
simplify 2 to the minus 4 times 2 to the 7th

solution_steps.explain: Multiplying powers of the same base pools the factors, so exponents add.

solution_steps.action: raise the base to the summed exponent
solution_steps.explain: The single power is the base with the combined exponent.

concepts.title: Dividing Powers and the Zero Exponent
concepts.definition: Dividing two powers of the same base cancels matching factors, leaving the base raised to the difference of the exponents; when the exponents are equal every factor cancels and the result is 1, which fixes the value of any nonzero base raised to 0.
concepts.key_idea: Halving a line of 2 to the 4th units three times is 2 to the 4th divided by 2 to the 3rd = 2.
concepts.textbook_ref: hegp102.txt lines 496-555 (other side of powers, zero exponent)
question_patterns: simplify 2 to the 100th divided by 2 to the 25th
what is 10 to the 5th divided by 10 to the 3rd - give the value
evaluate 4 to the 8th divided by 4 to the 3rd

find 24 divided by 2 to the 4th using exponents
simplify 3 to the 2nd times 3 to the minus 5th times 3 to the 6th

solution_steps.explain: Cancelling common factors removes exp_b copies of the base.

solution_steps.action: raise the base to the difference
solution_steps.explain: The quotient is the base with the reduced exponent; difference zero gives 1.

concepts.title: Negative Exponents
concepts.definition: Halving more times than the starting power needs forces exponents below zero, and a negative exponent means the reciprocal: n to the minus a equals 1 over n to the a, so 10 to the minus 3 is one thousandth.
concepts.key_idea: 2 to the minus 6 = 1 over 64: negative powers sit on the other side of 1 on the power line.
concepts.textbook_ref: hegp102.txt lines 556-599 (when zero is in power, negative exponents), 620-686 (power lines)
question_patterns: write 2 to the power minus 6 as a fraction

solution_steps.explain: Compute base raised to the positive exponent size.
A negative exponent flips the positive power into its reciprocal.

concepts.title: Powers of 10 and Scientific Notation
concepts.definition: Any number can be split into place-value powers of ten, and very large or small numbers are best written in scientific notation as a coefficient between 1 and 10 times a power of 10; the exponent carries the size of the number, which is what matters most for big facts like planet distances.
concepts.key_idea: 1433500000000 m = 1.4335 x 10 to the 12 m: the exponent 12 tells the number of digits.
question_patterns: write 5900 in scientific notation and verify its value
express the distance 1.439 x 10 to the 12 m as a full number of metres
write 8000000 in standard form and give the exponent

what does the exponent in 2 x 10 to the 7 tell about the population of Mumbai
convert 20800 to scientific notation

solution_steps.explain: 10 raised to the exponent gives the place-value scale.
Scaling the coefficient gives the ordinary number.

concepts.title: Exponential Growth by Doubling
concepts.definition: When a quantity doubles at every step - folded paper thickness, pond lotuses - its size after n steps is the starting amount times 2 to the n; this multiplicative growth explodes so fast that 46 folds of a 0.001 cm sheet cross the distance to the Moon.
concepts.key_idea: Every 10 extra folds make the thickness 1024 times bigger.
question_patterns: find the thickness of a 0.001 cm sheet after 46 folds
what is the thickness of folded paper after 10 folds if it doubles each fold
the lotus count doubles every day - how many lotuses after 30 days from one lotus
on which day was the doubling pond half full - explain
after how many folds does the sheet thickness cross 1 cm
calculate the folded thickness after 30 folds and compare with the Mariana Trench depth

solution_steps.explain: n doublings multiply the amount by 2 to the n.
Multiply the initial value by the growth factor.

concepts.title: Counting Password Combinations
concepts.definition: If every slot of a lock admits the same number of choices, the total number of passwords is that choice count raised to the number of slots; a 5-digit lock has 10 to the 5th passwords and a 6-letter lock from A to Z has 26 to the 6th.
concepts.key_idea: Each extra slot multiplies the count by the choices per slot.
question_patterns: how many passwords can a 5-digit lock have
find the number of possible passwords for a lock with 6 slots of letters A to Z
how many 3-digit passwords are possible with digits 0 to 9
calculate the combinations of 7 dresses, 2 hats and 3 pairs of shoes
how many 2-digit lock combinations exist
compare the password counts of a 5-digit lock and a 6-letter lock

solution_steps.action: raise choices to the slot count
solution_steps.explain: Every slot multiplies the total by the per-slot choices.
